ratios.facility: Credit Agreement (JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., administrative agent; $450 million Revolver)
ratios.quote: The Credit Agreement also contains a requirement that our Net Leverage Ratio shall not exceed 3.5 :1 as of the last day of any fiscal quarter.

parsed.notes: The excerpt states only the covenant limit; it gives no actual Net Leverage Ratio. Four items were left out. The 3:1 Net Leverage Ratio threshold is a restricted-payment carve-out condition, not a maintenance covenant. The 3.5:1 consolidated leverage ratio in the 2030 Notes indenture is a bond indenture dividend test. The Net Leverage Ratio also sets the interest spread, and the 0.20%–0.30% unused commitment fee depends on it; both of those are pricing uses, not covenants.
